name: Rachel
source:
The main bodyguard for Vargas. She is often seen guarding the outside of Vargus' quarters at his base of operations. 

She is a no-nonsense kind of woman and takes her role quite seriously. 

[spoiler]Rachel is sexually involved with Vargus as one of the many woman he sleeps with.[spoiler]

[spoiler]She does not take kindly to Luna's attitude to Vargus. She start's further resenting Luna after Luna forces her way into Vargus' quarters early in the story. 

Rachel also notices how Luna is cheating on Aiden and this makes Rachel think even less of  Luna than she already did. She notes that Aiden does not deserve how Luna is treating him.

The only reason that Rachel only does not tell Aiden about Luna's cheating is out of devotion to Vargus.[spoiler]
